explore-drive.title: Turn it up
explore-drive.prompt: The amplifier has a gain of 10. Turn up the input signal until the output can't follow any more.
hints: The output can't swing beyond 10 V. What input would need more than that?
Anything over 1 V in needs more than 10 V out.
explore-drive.success: Past 1 V in, the output needs more than 10 V and its peaks are clipped flat. The amplifier is non-linear now: the output is distorted.
